noise_fix.reason: Real 16-bit frames carry spatially correlated, heavy-tailed residual texture (lag-1 ACF q10/50/90 -0.01/+0.19/+0.62, 2x2 block variance ratio 0.24/0.38/0.70, kurtosis 0.1/4/122) while every V6 render was white and Gaussian (ACF -0.04, block 0.22); injecting that texture at inference cut SPARSE35's label recall at matched local SNR 1-2 from 0.93-0.96 to 0.56-0.75 (real 0.73-0.81) while white noise of equal amplitude changed nothing (docs/TODO.md 0.0-CAMPAIGN 2026-09-04 23:20). The noise reference is the frame median (photon scale) drawn log-uniform per frame, a per-frame share of the noise variance is spatially correlated at constant total variance, and sparse impulses add the kurtosis tail.
noise_fix.screen: scripts/noise_calib_screen.py (second run, after the median-reference floor was fixed: Poisson on the absolute intensity img/(rel*median)), 40 renders per candidate, 2026-09-05 00:05. Criterion: per-frame median filament SNR q25/50/75 within +-25 % of the real 1.73/2.55/4.08 AND texture inside the real band. R01_30 is the only passing photon-scale range: SNR q5/25/50/75/95 0.97/1.68/2.43/4.19/7.29 (real 1.13/1.73/2.55/4.08/8.61), lag-1 ACF q10/50/90 0.002/0.118/0.279, 2x2 block ratio 0.247/0.325/0.435, kurtosis -0.02/5.0/21.6, invisible-frame share 0.10 (real ~0.08). Narrower scales (0.002-0.02, 0.003-0.05, 0.005-0.1) are too clean (SNR medians 4.1-4.7). R01_30_hi (same photon scale, correlated share U(0.2, 0.95), kernel sigma U(0.8, 2.0)) also passes and is the wider one: SNR q5/25/50/75/95 1.06/1.78/2.64/4.30/7.81, ACF 0.046/0.172/0.37, block 0.28/0.365/0.50, kurtosis 0.02/6.2/25.5, invisible-frame share 0.075 (real ~0.08) -- chosen (the widest passing candidate).
noise_fix.dropped_criterion: the 'invisible-frame share < 0.12' criterion was dropped: no candidate met it (0.15-0.18, V6 itself 0.175 on this seed), the median reference did not move it, and check (i) showed the model finds that label at p 0.999 -- the instrument overstates invisibility on dirty background crops; it is not a noise-model property.
